documents.name: support digest
documents.text:
From: Support
Subject: Weekly support digest

This week the support desk answered questions about password resets, printer access, the VPN rollout, and the new help pages. The most common topic was the office move, and the team wrote a short guide about desk bookings, meeting etiquette, badge photos, and the kitchen rota. Response times improved again. The digest also covers the training calendar, the buddy scheme for new joiners, the lost property box, and the survey about Friday hours. Next week the desk will publish the holiday rota and the updated guide to booking focus rooms, plus a note about the budget for office supplies and the catering rota for the training days.

documents.text:
From: Social Committee
Subject: Launch party

The launch party is booked for the Friday after the launch, in the courtyard. The party budget is 3000 dollars for food and music. Volunteers for setup should arrive an hour early. There will be a short speech from the team lead and a group photo on the steps. Please tell the committee about allergies before Wednesday so the menu can be adjusted, and bring your badge for the raffle at the end.
